object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Work out incoming coverage of a requirements document against a test document whose objects verify two of its three objects, all three, or, for a one-object document, none. Expected: 2 of 3 covered (66.7 %) with the unlinked object uncovered; 3 of 3 (100 %); 0 of 1 (0 %).
